description: Bosch BMP280 — digital barometric pressure sensor, 300-1100 hPa range, ±1 hPa absolute accuracy, I2C/SPI interface. LGA-8 package. Includes temperature sensor.
name: bmp280-bosch-sensor
watch_out_for: I2C address 0x76 (SDO low) or 0x77 (SDO high). Requires 1.8-3.6V supply; not 5V tolerant. Forced-mode draws ~0.65mA — use normal mode for battery.
